column1: # game.mode: each subclass of GameMode stores the parameters of its win condition, and every one of
# them is pinned by the class's own objective text and by isObjectiveComplete():
#   EscortMode: b()/a(PlayerList) = the escorting side (compared with contains(player) in
#     getObjectiveText) -> getEscortPlayers/setEscortPlayers ; a(int) is the truck count printed as
#     "Escort {0} trucks" -> getTruckCount/setTruckCount ; a(Vec2) is the destination the trucks are
#     distance-checked against ("reach the target area (blue)") -> getTargetArea/setTargetArea ;
#   SurvivalMode: the same three shapes for "safeguard at least {0} base stations" and the surviving
#   CaptureTheFlagMode: a(Unit) is the flag unit -> getFlag/setFlag ; a(float) is the hold time
#     printed in "Hold the flag for {0} seconds" -> getHoldSeconds/setHoldSeconds ; b(float) is the
#     timestamp the hold started at (isObjectiveComplete: gameTime - start >= seconds)
#   AnnihilationMode: a(long) is the total-health threshold a player must still field
#   SupremacyMode: a(float) is the fraction of the map's structures needed (rounded in the private
# AmmoType: the enum constants carry ("Bullets[i18n]: Bullets", "BULLETS", speed, turnRate, burst,
#   burstAnimationDuration) and each accessor maps onto one of those columns:
#   a() returns the uppercase key (same role as UnitType.getKey) -> getKey ;
#   b() is the projectile speed in tiles/s (Bullets 5.0 .. Torpedo 0.4) -> getSpeed ;
#   c() is the turn rate in rad/s (Bullets 2000*pi = effectively instant, Missile pi = slow homing)
#   d()/e() are the burst pair (Missile 10, others 0) -> hasSubProjectiles / getSubProjectileCount ;
#   f() is the burst animation duration in seconds (non-zero only for the missile; GameScreen
#     divides the elapsed time by it to pick the animation frame) -> getAnimationDuration.
#   The static field f is the maximum of e() over all constants; it belongs to the field batch.
